SE: Crowd noise

I had a feeling I'd been cleverly tricked somehow, but...
Watching Gold Ship run had genuinely thrilled me, so—

How'd you like my real skills?!
Now that's what you call Golshi-chan's running style—!!

A-At this rate, my burning spirit's gonna run dry,
and I might not be able to run properly...!

And now, around the final bend and into the home stretch!
The leader is breaking away! Is it all over already?!

Lookin' at your face, seems like you had a total blast!
Best expression you've made yet!
~ Gold Ship: Earth Arc - Fin ~

So it's treasure hunting time! Treasure hunt!!
We're going on a journey to find the root of our frustration!!!

Well, well, you've got good reactions and you're easy to mess with,
so you're alright in my book!

First up, an exclusive ambush interview with our rookie Trainer☆
Tell us your thoughts heading into today's race!

Ahem, reporting live from the racetrack.
Your broadcast is brought to you by everyone's favorite, Golshi-chan!
—Welp, it's about that time.

How many days till the next race?!
Three days?! Two days?!
Man, this guy's got way too much free time on their hands... y'know?

Rain or shine, day after day, with that look of pure conviction in your eyes...
Watching that, I realized something—

Our next destination is outer spaaaace!!
Here we goooooooo—!!
WOOOOOOOOOOOO—!!
Alright then, guess that means you're continuing as my Trainer!

Aight, time to unleash all that frustration with a bang!
Burn this sight deep into your retinas—!!

Despite being thoroughly dragged around by her, as I watched Gold Ship leave,
I found myself wondering what kind of running she was truly capable of.

Here comes Gold Ship making an astonishing surge from behind!
Three lengths to the lead! Now one length!

Whoa whoa, what are you, the immersion police?!
I literally said "That's right" like five times already.

Right, right?! Faster than anyone! Stealing the spotlight and winning!
That's the absolute essence of my style!

What a magnificent race...!
I was completely captivated by her running.

I need your help today, so get your head in the game.
I mean, you need a Trainer to enter the Twinkle Series, right?
The day after safely returning to the academy with Gold Ship—

I managed to BS my way through the registration without a Trainer,
but it looks like my luck ran out today.
Yeah! Let's protect the peace of humanity together!!

You were always standing at the edge of the track,
watching us Umamusume run, right?

Huuuh?! ...You still haven't figured out
why I picked you as my Trainer?

I ended up having to desperately hold back Gold Ship
from blasting off into space...

Gold Ship, the most wild and grandiose Umamusume of all.
It seemed being her Trainer was going to take a lot more work.

She takes the lead right at the wire, and that's the finish!!!!
Gold Ship claims a spectacular victory in her debut race!
Her start was decent, and holding a good position, the race unfolded—

WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHH—!!
I DON'T HAVE ENOUGH FRUSTRATION—!!
(Chatter... Murmur...)
And with that, the gates opened for Gold Ship's debut race!

And so, her debut race came to a safe conclusion,
and I officially became Gold Ship's Trainer, but—

HECK YEAAAAAAAH—!
VICTORY—!!
